subject: Orchid Health — request for BCP attestation + live witness coordination
messages:
From: Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@orchidhealth.com>
To: jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@orchidhealth.com
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: BCP evidence & attestation request — Orchid Health procurement

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement & IT risk are collecting materials for our board review and need a concise package from Redwood to close the security review. Two asks up front:

1) Can you provide an attested RTO/RPO statement (signed by an authorized Redwood representative) that covers hosted API and Dedicated modes? We need specifics by workload class (low, medium, high) and region.

2) We also request recent runbook-level artifacts and one successful live witness window where Orchid can observe a restore/replay (or a replay log) for a warm standby activation. Ideally the witness would be within the next two weeks.

Please include any SOC 2 / SIG cross-references to the artifacts if possible. Procurement wants to confirm the delivery timeline by EOD Friday.

Appreciate your help — Sarah

Sarah Patel
IT Risk Manager, Orchid Health
sarah.patel@orchidhealth.com

From: jasmine.liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@orchidhealth.com>
Cc: procurement@orchidhealth.com
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BCP evidence & attestation request — Orchid Health procurement

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear list.

We can absolutely provide an attested statement and the runbook materials. Quick summary of the plan:

- I will attach a concise BCP summary + the specific RTO/RPO matrix across Hosted / Dedicated / Private. That covers the low/medium/high workload bands you described.
- Ben (cc'd) will attach the RPO/RTO test log and the restore/replay transcript from our July warm standby exercise; that should satisfy the replay/log asks.
- For live witness: we can schedule a 45-minute window next week (Aug 11–13) for a controlled playback and short Q&A. If you prefer a video witness + live console, we can do both.

Action items for Orchid: confirm which region(s) you need witness coverage for (us-west, us-east, eu-west). Also confirm whether procurement needs the attestation as a PDF or signed DocuSign.

I attached: redwood_bcp_summary_v2.pdf (high-level + RTO/RPO matrix). Ben will send the logs.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Manager, Security Response — Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai

From: Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@orchidhealth.com>
To: ben.carter@redwood.ai, jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 7 Aug 2026 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BCP evidence & attestation request — Orchid Health follow-up

Thanks Ben — the timestamps and operator notes look helpful. A couple follow-ups from our risk team:

- Please confirm whether the restore times reported include full system rehydration (keystore, secrets access) or just application-state replay. We need an end-to-end RTO estimate.
- We will want the attestation returned via DocuSign; can you send the version to the procurement mailbox (procurement@orchidhealth.com) for signing?
- For the live witness: us-west coverage is sufficient. Could you offer two windows (morning and late-afternoon PT) so our IT team can choose?

If you can confirm those three items by Monday EOD, procurement will close the security review.

Best,
Sarah

From: jasmine.liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@orchidhealth.com>, procurement@orchidhealth.com
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, priya.natarajan@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BCP evidence & attestation request — scheduling & DocuSign

Hi Sarah — quick updates and confirmations.

1) End-to-end RTO: the numbers Ben provided are application-replay-only. Full end-to-end restore (including keystore rehydration and HSM key unlock in our private deployments) adds ~90–120s on average for the high lane; listed below is conservative worst-case:
   - Low workload lane: 3m 45s end-to-end
   - Medium workload lane: 7m 45s end-to-end
   - High workload lane: 13m 45s end-to-end

2) DocuSign: I uploaded the attestation to DocuSign and sent to procurement@orchidhealth.com (link below). It uses our standard attestation language; Legal has pre-approved the signatory (VP of Ops).
   - DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/embersign/ABC123-orchid-bcp-attest
\3) Live witness windows (us-west-2): proposing
   - Tue Aug 11, 10:00–10:45 PT (morning)
   - Wed Aug 12, 16:00–16:45 PT (late-afternoon)
\Please confirm preferred slot and whether you want screen-share + console access or a recording-only observation. We will allocate a runbook owner and an operations engineer to walk through the steps.
\Attachments: bcps_attestation_template.docx (updated with signatory block).
\Thanks — Jasmine
